gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 S3 reduced scalar Faddeev-Senjanovic zeta determinant
scope: For the already-proven nondegenerate reduced scalar/conformal second-class block on round S3, freeze a dimensionless spectral-zeta prescription for the positive Faddeev-Senjanovic factor sqrt(det C)=|mu_l| and determine its zeta-regularized determinant. This gate does not construct the complete HMT constraint matrix or full HMT determinant.

frozen_spectrum.dimensionless_operator: A_hat = a^4 |C12| on the reduced scalar domain
frozen_spectrum.domain: l=0 and l>=2; l=1 gauge modes excluded

frozen_regularization.spectral_zeta: zeta_A(s)=sum_{l in reduced domain} d_l lambda_l^(-s)
frozen_regularization.determinant_definition: Det_zeta(A_hat)=exp[-zeta_A'(0)] provided analytic continuation is regular at s=0
frozen_regularization.FS_interpretation: This determinant is the regularized product of sqrt(det [[0,mu_l],[-mu_l,0]])=|mu_l| after multiplication by a^4 per eigenvalue.
frozen_regularization.signed_C12_phase: not used; the ell=0 sign is removed by the positive FS square-root factor
frozen_regularization.normalization: A_hat=a^4|C12| is frozen; any multiplicative rescaling c A_hat must be tracked through zeta_A(0) and is not silently identified with the same determinant

required_checks: Construct an explicit analytic continuation around s=0, not merely a finite cutoff product.
Verify the continuation is regular at s=0 and compute zeta_A(0) and zeta_A'(0) with controlled numerical convergence.
Cross-check the continuation against the directly convergent spectral sum at at least one Re(s)>3/2 value.
Compute the finite positive dimensionless Det_zeta(A_hat)=exp[-zeta_A'(0)] only if the above checks pass.
Explicitly test normalization dependence using Det_zeta(c A_hat)=c^(zeta_A(0)) Det_zeta(A_hat); do not claim normalization independence unless zeta_A(0)=0.
Do not treat this reduced scalar determinant as the complete HMT Faddeev-Senjanovic determinant, complete zero-mode quotient, or one-loop effective action.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter coefficients, change thresholds, allow soft-s retest, or unblock k=0.03 production.
pass_condition: The frozen reduced scalar spectral zeta admits a regular analytic continuation at s=0, direct-sum cross-checks agree, a finite positive Det_zeta(A_hat) is computed for the frozen normalization, and any nonzero normalization dependence is explicitly retained while all full-HMT/C9 claims remain open.
fail_condition: The analytic continuation is singular or numerically unstable at s=0, disagrees with convergent-domain direct sums beyond frozen tolerance, a remaining reduced zero mode appears, or any frozen full-theory semantic restriction is weakened.
